{"args":["-lc","cd /app && /usr/bin/Rscript -e '
source("/app/ars.R")
# 1. aliases + extra-arg forwarding + expression/formula inputs
set.seed(7); a1 <- ars(500, g = dnorm)
set.seed(7); a2 <- ars(500, dens = dnorm)
cat("alias g==dens:", isTRUE(all.equal(a1, a2)), "\n")
set.seed(7); b1 <- ars(500, dnorm, mean = 3, sd = 0.5)
cat(sprintf("forward mean/sd: mean=%.2f sd=%.2f\n", mean(b1), sd(b1)))
set.seed(7); e1 <- ars(300, expression(dnorm(x)))
cat(sprintf("expression: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f\n", mean(e1), sd(e1)))
set.seed(7); f1 <- ars(300, ~dnorm(x))
cat(sprintf("formula: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f\n", mean(f1), sd(f1)))
set.seed(7); l1 <- ars(300, function(v) dexp(v, rate = 1), lb = 0, ub = Inf)
cat(sprintf("lb/ub alias: mean=%.3f (truth 1)\n", mean(l1)))
# 2. other log-concave targets
set.seed(11); g2 <- ars(2000, function(v) dgamma(v, shape = 2, rate = 1), a = 0, b = Inf)
cat(sprintf("gamma(2,1): mean=%.3f sd=%.3f (truth 2, 1.414)\n", mean(g2), sd(g2)))
set.seed(12); bt <- ars(2000, function(v) dbeta(v, 2, 2), a = 0, b = 1)
cat(sprintf("beta(2,2): mean=%.3f sd=%.3f (truth 0.5, 0.224)\n", mean(bt), sd(bt)))
set.seed(13); lp <- ars(2000, function(v) exp(-abs(v)))
cat(sprintf("laplace: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f (truth 0, 1.414)\n", mean(lp), sd(lp)))
# 3. analytic derivative path
set.seed(14); nd <- ars(1000, dnorm, dlogdens = function(v) -v)
cat(sprintf("analytic deriv: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f\n", mean(nd), sd(nd)))
# 4. user x0
set.seed(15); x0s <- ars(500, dnorm, x0 = c(-1, 0, 1))
cat(sprintf("x0 given: mean=%.3f sd=%.3f\n", mean(x0s), sd(x0s)))
# 5. violation hidden in far tail -> must be caught mid-sampling, not silently sampled
kink <- function(v) ifelse(v < 2, dnorm(v), dnorm(2) * exp(-0.1 * (v - 2)))
r <- tryCatch({ ars(200, kink, x0 = c(-1, 0, 1)); "NO ERROR (BAD)" }, error = function(e) paste("error:", conditionMessage(e)))
cat("kink-tail:", substr(r, 1, 120), "\n")
# 6. reproducibility
set.seed(99); r1 <- ars(200, dnorm); set.seed(99); r2 <- ars(200, dnorm)
cat("reproducible:", identical(r1, r2), "\n")
# 7. sample files
for (f in c("/app/normal_samples.txt", "/app/exponential_samples.txt")) {
  v <- scan(f, quiet = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf("%s: n=%d finite=%s mean=%.3f sd=%.3f\n", f, length(v), all(is.finite(v)), mean(v), sd(v)))
}
'"],"command":"bash","timeout_ms":300000}
